configurations.//: Use this when a dev server is ALREADY running (the usual case). No command — it just points the preview at the running server. `next dev` refuses to start a second instance in the same folder, so starting another one only kills itself.
configurations.name: Attach to Dev Server

configurations.//: Only when nothing is running yet. autoPort is off on purpose: a second instance on a shuffled port dies on Next's duplicate-server guard anyway, so failing loudly on a busy 3000 is the honest outcome.
configurations.name: Next.js Dev Server

configurations.//: HTTPS dev server — Facebook's JS SDK (WhatsApp Embedded Signup) refuses plain http.
configurations.name: Next.js Dev Server (HTTPS)
